svg.title: Pulsus Dash — AWS region eu-west-1 as an isometric architecture diagram (City view, Architecture style, INC-2041)
svg.desc: City view (⌥3) of AWS account prod-payments in region eu-west-1, drawn in the Architecture style: an isometric 3D reference-architecture diagram. Group boundaries are stacked translucent trays with the usual coloured edges and corner tags: AWS Cloud (account prod-payments), the Edge zone, Region eu-west-1 (dashed), VPC 10.20.0.0/16, three Availability Zones eu-west-1a, 1b and 1c (dashed), and each zone runs from a public subnet at the front through a private app subnet to a private data subnet at the back. Services are extruded square tiles whose top carries the category colour and a simple line glyph, with the service name and one metric underneath. Requests enter at the front left and flow left to right, rising across the trays: Users (1.8k requests/s) resolve through Route 53 (shop.example.com) and enter CloudFront with an attached WAF tile (cache hit 91 %, 1.2k blocked per minute); CloudFront reads static assets from the S3 bucket assets as its origin. The internet gateway sits on the VPC border; one Application Load Balancer alb-checkout is drawn in eu-west-1b with thin links to its nodes in the other two public subnets; each public subnet has a NAT gateway. The Amazon EKS cluster prod-eu-1 is an orange group spanning the three private app subnets, with the managed control plane (API p99 180 ms) at its left edge outside the VPC and a dashed EKS node group of two EC2 nodes per zone, each carrying small pod cubes. Aurora pg-orders has a writer in 1a and readers in 1b and 1c joined by a replication link. Outside the VPC at the back, the DynamoDB tables orders and inventory are reached through a gateway VPC endpoint on the VPC border, and a global-table link leaves the region towards us-east-1. Healthy services carry no badge. The ALB is Degraded (target 5xx 4.1 %), the checkout pods on EKS are Degraded (p95 1.9 s) and DynamoDB orders is in Watch (120 throttles per minute); each has a state badge at the tile corner and a soft ring on the tray. The external payment provider psp-api, outside the AWS Cloud, is Failing and marked as the probable origin; a dashed red link from EKS through the NAT gateway reads timeouts. The live request path Users, Route 53, CloudFront, WAF, internet gateway, ALB, EKS, VPC endpoint, DynamoDB orders is lit in accent blue with particles. Top: product bar with the breadcrumb aws, prod-payments, eu-west-1 and the INC-2041 chip (checkout degraded since 12:22, about €38k/h at risk), and a view row with City active and the style switch Neutral or Architecture. Right: a slim panel for the selected ALB with one target 5xx chart for 12:00 to 12:35 marked with the 12:19 config change, and the request path with per-hop latency. Three numbered callouts. Bottom: Time Ribbon.

g.text: INC-2041 · checkout degraded since 12:22 · ~€38k/h at risk
Groups are trays: Cloud › Region › VPC › AZ › subnet
Services keep their architecture icons; health is the badge
The live request path is lit end to end
